/**
 * EventEmitter service for tracking platform events
 *
 * Features:
 * - Session ID generation and persistence
 * - Event batching (max 10 events or 5 seconds)
 * - Retry logic with exponential backoff
 * - Graceful degradation on errors
 */const API_BASE_URL='http://localhost:8000';const MAX_BATCH_SIZE=10;const BATCH_TIMEOUT_MS=5000;// 5 seconds
const MAX_RETRIES=3;const INITIAL_RETRY_DELAY_MS=1000;// 1 second
class EventEmitter{constructor(){this.sessionId=this._initializeSessionId();this.eventQueue=[];this.batchTimer=null;this.isSending=false;}/**
   * Initialize or retrieve session ID from sessionStorage
   * @private
   * @returns {string} Session ID (UUID v4)
   */_initializeSessionId(){// Check if session ID already exists
let sessionId=sessionStorage.getItem('session_id');if(!sessionId){// Generate new session ID (UUID v4)
sessionId=crypto.randomUUID();sessionStorage.setItem('session_id',sessionId);console.log('[EventEmitter] Generated new session ID:',sessionId);}else{console.log('[EventEmitter] Using existing session ID:',sessionId);}return sessionId;}/**
   * Get current session ID
   * @returns {string} Session ID
   */getSessionId(){return this.sessionId;}/**
   * Emit a platform event
   *
   * @param {string} eventName - Name of the event (e.g., 'page_viewed', 'task_created')
   * @param {string} userId - User ID
   * @param {Object} [properties={}] - Event-specific properties
   *
   * @example
   * eventEmitter.emit('page_viewed', 'user-123', { page: '/tasks' });
   */emit(eventName,userId){let properties=arguments.length>2&&arguments[2]!==undefined?arguments[2]:{};const event={event_name:eventName,user_id:userId,session_id:this.sessionId,properties:properties};// Add event to queue
this.eventQueue.push(event);console.log("[EventEmitter] Queued event: ".concat(eventName," (queue size: ").concat(this.eventQueue.length,")"));// Flush if batch size reached
if(this.eventQueue.length>=MAX_BATCH_SIZE){console.log('[EventEmitter] Batch size reached, flushing...');this.flush();}else{// Set timer to flush after timeout
this._scheduleBatchFlush();}}/**
   * Schedule a batch flush after timeout
   * @private
   */_scheduleBatchFlush(){// Clear existing timer
if(this.batchTimer){clearTimeout(this.batchTimer);}// Schedule new flush
this.batchTimer=setTimeout(()=>{console.log('[EventEmitter] Batch timeout reached, flushing...');this.flush();},BATCH_TIMEOUT_MS);}/**
   * Immediately flush all queued events to backend
   * @returns {Promise<void>}
   */async flush(){// Clear batch timer
if(this.batchTimer){clearTimeout(this.batchTimer);this.batchTimer=null;}// Skip if no events or already sending
if(this.eventQueue.length===0||this.isSending){return;}// Get events to send
const eventsToSend=[...this.eventQueue];this.eventQueue=[];this.isSending=true;try{await this._sendEvents(eventsToSend);console.log("[EventEmitter] Successfully sent ".concat(eventsToSend.length," events"));}catch(error){console.error('[EventEmitter] Failed to send events after retries:',error);// Graceful degradation - events are lost but app continues
}finally{this.isSending=false;}}/**
   * Send events to backend with retry logic
   * @private
   * @param {Array} events - Events to send
   * @param {number} [retryCount=0] - Current retry attempt
   * @returns {Promise<Object>} Response from backend
   */async _sendEvents(events){let retryCount=arguments.length>1&&arguments[1]!==undefined?arguments[1]:0;try{const response=await fetch("".concat(API_BASE_URL,"/events"),{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Session-Id':this.sessionId},body:JSON.stringify({events:events})});if(!response.ok){throw new Error("HTTP ".concat(response.status,": ").concat(response.statusText));}const data=await response.json();// Log validation errors if any
if(data.validation_errors&&data.validation_errors.length>0){console.warn('[EventEmitter] Some events failed validation:',data.validation_errors);}return data;}catch(error){// Retry logic
if(retryCount<MAX_RETRIES){const delay=INITIAL_RETRY_DELAY_MS*Math.pow(2,retryCount);// Exponential backoff
console.warn("[EventEmitter] Send failed (attempt ".concat(retryCount+1,"/").concat(MAX_RETRIES+1,"), retrying in ").concat(delay,"ms..."));await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,delay));return this._sendEvents(events,retryCount+1);}else{throw error;}}}/**
   * Clear session ID and generate a new one
   * Useful for testing or manual session reset
   */resetSession(){sessionStorage.removeItem('session_id');this.sessionId=this._initializeSessionId();console.log('[EventEmitter] Session reset');}}// Create singleton instance
const eventEmitter=new EventEmitter();export default eventEmitter;
